Tanzania
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in London, United Kingdom or bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Cairo, Egypt.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens (Visa shell be issued in Geneva):
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
From November 30, 2024, the possibility of issuing a visa on arrival in the Republic of Tanzania will be abolished and an online visa application system will be introduced. More detailed information can be found at the web address: https://visa.immigration.go.tz/Diplomatic Mission of United Republic of Tanzania, Geneva:
Address: 47 Avenue Blanc, 1202 GeneveTel: +41 22 731 89 20Fax: +41 22 732 82 55E-mail: mission.tanzania@ties.itu.intWeb: www.tanzania-mission.chBusiness hours: Monday - Friday, 09,00 - 12,00
Citizens of the United Republic of Tanzania are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.
